lines: I'm so glad winter turned out cold
So that your chilled left hand
Could be invited into my right pocket —
There could be no better reason than that
"I wish it would snow," you said, pouting
Things never go the way you want
Don't kick the fallen leaves — you'll slip and fall again
Why do you look so happy when you're mad?
On the carpet of snow, still untouched and beautiful
The two of us carve parallel lines of footprints
Even if a dream-story like this never comes true
Smiles keep spilling out
On a road without snow
Walking together takes a little knack
Your steps are short
I'll take my time and take in the view
The view with you there, looking back
On the curtain of the sky, still dry
The two of us play an orchestra of footsteps
Look — even before the dream-story comes true
You're the one who gives me smiles
I know that much
On the carpet of snow, still untouched and beautiful
The two of us carve parallel lines of footprints
Yes — even without wishing for it
The dream-story showed me smiles
It showed me the road I walk
I'm so glad I met you
The same seasons come around again
The memory I kept in my right pocket
I'll walk on keeping it tucked away, after all
On a road without you
On a road without you (Snow smile, snow smile)
On a road without you — the road, the road, yeah yeah
